summary_en: FY26 annual dividend raised to ¥19/share (+¥9 vs FY25 actual ¥10/share). Payout ratio 28.5%, DOE 5.79%. Progressive dividend policy adopted (maintenance or increase in dividends, no reduction in principle).
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) and Determination of Dividend Policy (Introduction of Progressive Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
IBJ announced on 14 August 2026 that its board has revised the FY26 annual dividend forecast from the prior guidance of ¥13/share to ¥19/share, an increase of ¥9 per share against FY25 actual of ¥10/share. The revision reflects strong interim performance (H1 FY26) and balances aggressive shareholder returns against retained earnings earmarked for M&A and new business investments. Against FY26 full-year profit guidance, the revised ¥19/share dividend implies a payout ratio of 28.5% and a Dividend on Equity (DOE) of 5.79%.

Concurrently, IBJ has adopted a progressive dividend policy framework, whereby the company commits in principle not to reduce dividends year-on-year; future declarations will maintain or increase the prior payout. This policy is designed to strengthen shareholder returns and enhance transparency and predictability of capital allocation over the medium to long term. The company states it will continue to pursue sustainable growth and long-term corporate value creation through capital-cost and share-price-conscious management.
